senses.gloss: चय् cl. 1. ˚यते, to go, Dhātup. xiv, 5;
चय् [cf. κίω, κινέω; Lat. cieo; Lith. koja, ‘foot’.]
1. चय mfn. ‘collecting’, see वृतं-
चय m. (iii, 3, 56, Kāś.; g. वृषादि) a mound of earth (raised to form the foundation of a building or raised as a rampart), MBh. iii, 11699; Hariv.; R.; Pañcat.
a cover, covering, W.
a heap, pile, collection, multitude, assemblage, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
(in med.) accumulation of the humors (cf. सं-), Suśr.
the amount by which each term increases, common increase or difference of the terms, Bījag. (cf. अग्नि-).
2. चय mfn. ifc. ‘revenging’, see ऋणं-.
चायक mfn., Pāṇ. vi, 1, 78, Kāś.
चयक mfn. = चये कुशल, g. आकर्षादि.
चायनीय mfn. ‘perceptible’, Nir. xii, 6 and 16.
चयनीय mfn. to be heaped or collected (पुण्य), Vop. xxvi, 3.
2. चायमान॑ m. patr. of Abhyāvartin, RV. vi, 27, 5 and 8
(for 1. चा॑य्˚ See s.v. √ चाय्.)
चायितृ mfn. one who observes, Nir. v, 25.
चायु॑ mfn. showing respect, RV. iii, 24, 4.
च॑यन n. piling up (wood &c.), AV. xviii, 4, 37; ŚBr. ix f.; KātyŚr. xvi; Hariv. 2161, Sch.
stacked wood, MBh. iii, vii, xiv
collecting, W.
चयन—कारिका f. N. of wk.
चयन—पद्धति f. N. of wk.
चयन—प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
चयन—सूत्र n. N. of wk.
चय—˚नान्त mfn. concluding with (the erection of) a Śmaśāna, HirP.
